name: Pagination
description: Steps through content split across numbered pages.

totalPages.description: Total number of pages; renders nothing when there are none

siblingCount.description: Pages shown on each side of the current one; the first and last page always show

size.description: Item size; resolves through ComponentDefaults when omitted

renderLink.description: Makes every page a link: (page) => the element to render, such as an anchor or a router link. Pressing it still calls onPageChange

when: Data sets served a page at a time
Tables and lists with a known total
Search results past the first screen
whenNot: Everything already fits on one page
Content that loads as the user scrolls
guidelines: Sit it directly below what it pages
The first and last page always show; siblingCount sets how many neighbours show
The current page takes the selection wash and ring, not the brand accent
Pass renderLink when each page has its own URL
The root forwards id, aria-*, data-*, and handlers to <nav>
A step's onClick runs first — call preventDefault() to stop the change
accessibility: Steps at the boundaries are disabled buttons, even in link mode

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Neighbours around the current page, ends always reachable.

examples.name: Many Pages
examples.description: The first and last page stay; gaps fold into an ellipsis.

examples.name: Compact
examples.description: Drops the neighbours when space is tight.

examples.name: Controlled
examples.description: You hold the page number in state.

examples.name: Link Pages
examples.description: Each page is a link to its own URL.

relations.note: Use Listbox for small sets of options

propsSummary: totalPages: number - total page count (required); nothing renders at 0
siblingCount: number - pages around current (default: 1); first and last always show
Forwards standard HTML nav attributes to the root element
